title: Spring-Ford and Pope John Paul II volleyball both win state titles
summary: Spring-Ford took the last six points of a fifth set to beat Hempfield 3-2 Friday for its second straight PIAA 6A championship, and Pope John Paul II beat Oakland Catholic 3-1 Saturday for its fifth state title in a row, this time in Class 4A.
loc: Spring-Ford and Pope John Paul II high schools, Royersford

title: Spring-Ford football hands Downingtown East its first loss to reach the district final
summary: The Rams won 17-14 at Downingtown East in Friday's District 1 6A semifinal, seven weeks after losing badly to the same team. Spring-Ford plays at Central Bucks West on Nov. 27 in its first district final since 2012.

title: Limerick's 2027 budget leaves out money for the $30 million community center
summary: Supervisors voted 3-0 Tuesday to advertise a $27.7 million budget with no funding for more study of the proposed park community center, after residents spent the meeting urging the township not to rush it. The only tax change is a small hydrant-tax bump to cover a 32% water company increase.

title: Icelandic sauna now taking bookings near Valley Forge park
summary: Dottir Spa, a wood-fired sauna on a trailer run by two Icelandic sibling couples, has started private guided sessions about a quarter mile from the park's southern edge, with cold plunges between rounds. A booking for up to 12 people is $1,990, and the owners will also tow the sauna to a driveway or event.
loc: Near Valley Forge National Historical Park

title: Phoenixville Hospital earns an A for patient safety after years of C grades
summary: The Leapfrog Group's fall ratings gave the Tower Health hospital its top grade, ending a run of eight straight C's dating to 2022. It scored best on error-prevention practices and on avoiding falls and blood clots, with weaker marks for post-surgery kidney injury and some infections.

title: Kitchen and Canvas opens cooking and art classes in Collegeville
summary: The new studio in the Marketplace at Collegeville opened Nov. 13 with workshops in pasta making, sushi, sourdough, holiday baking and paint-and-sip, plus camps and group events. It is open 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. daily, with bookings taken online.

title: Chicken Salad Chick opens in Collegeville
summary: The Southern fast-casual chain's first Montgomery County restaurant held its grand opening Nov. 18, giving the first 100 guests free chicken salad for a year. It is open seven days a week, 10:30 a.m. to 8:30 p.m.
loc: 500 Broad St., Providence Town Center, Collegeville

title: Essendant distribution center in Upper Providence closes, 150 jobs lost
summary: The office-supply wholesaler's warehouse on Green Tree Road shut on Oct. 3 as the company winds down nationwide, and its 150 local workers could not be moved to other sites.
loc: 125 Green Tree Road, Upper Providence (near Oaks)

title: La Patrona closes its Bridge Street restaurant Nov. 22
summary: The Mexican restaurant and tequila bar ends five years downtown with a final service on Sunday, Nov. 22. The owners say they are looking for a new location and hope to reopen, possibly in a different format.

title: Abele family commits nearly $1 million a year to Ursinus scholars
summary: The Abele Family Foundation, which started Ursinus College's Abele Scholars program in 2018, has pledged close to $1 million annually to keep it going as the college picks its 10th class. The program takes 15 students with financial need each fall and pairs aid with mentoring and career prep.

title: Great American Pub hosts a Christmas Bazaar with Santa Dec. 12
summary: The free bazaar runs noon to 4 p.m. on Saturday, Dec. 12, with gifts from local artists and seasonal food and drink. Santa visits from noon to 2 p.m.

title: Judge lets neighbors join the fight over the Pennhurst data center
summary: A Chester County judge ruled Nov. 10 that the owners of an adjoining 130-acre farm and the group East Vincent Advocacy may help defend the township's rejection of a hyperscale data center on about 125 acres of the former Pennhurst property. Supervisors unanimously denied the plan in May, and it stays denied while the developer's appeal proceeds.
loc: 1205 Commonwealth Drive, East Vincent Township (near Spring City)
